pro_course_detail.description:
These lessons are based on Gayle Laakmann McDowell's Cracking the Coding Interview (CTCI) book. This is for students who are already familiar with topics from CTCI in their native language but who are looking to get stronger discussing Stack/Queues/Strings/Tree/Graphs/System Design/etc in English.

Please just do a single class to start. The first class addresses _how_ to answer a question AKA the Problem Solving flowchart. (listen, example, brute force, optimize using BUD, walk through, implement, test)

Lesson Schedule:

0: The Problem-Solving Flowchart
1. Arrays and Strings
2. Linked Lists
3. Stacks and Queues
4. Trees and Graphs
5. Bit Manipulation
6. Math and Logic Puzzles
7. Object-Oriented Design
8. Recursion and DP
9. System Design and Scalability
10. Sorting and Search

Typical Class:
- Before the class: you read the next chapter
- In class, I give you an _easy_ question from the lesson
- You answer (following the flow chart) using pseudocode
- I give you hints and English tips as we go
- After class, you read and prepare the next lesson

Please message me when booking this class and tell me your stack!!!

Important!!! If you're looking to do this class but the price is too high, message me. I'm also looking for students to do it for my YT channel. For those students, the price is lower. Message me if this interests you.

In our meetings, we will practice delivering effective and concise responses to various types of interview questions that go beyond technical questions related to your work (depending on your needs).  Although we can practice questions directly related to your line of work, we will most likely focus on mastering responses to questions including the following structures:
1) Tell me about yourself.
2) Tell me about a time when you. . . (describing past accomplishments and work experiences)
3) Two-part questions, e.g., Describe your leadership style, and tell me about a time where you successfully handled a conflict among your team members. 
4) Hypothetical questions, e.g., What would you do if you had an upcoming deadline that you most likely were not going to meet? 

Additionally, you can expect to receive feedback on the following: grammar, pronunciation, word choice, fluency, eye contact, body language, facial expressions, level of confidence, etc.

During our sessions, we will have a mock interview where I will assume the role of the hiring manager, and you will be the job candidate.  During the practice interview, I will take comprehensive notes on your performance. You will be provided the notes at the end of our session, and I can also give a video link to a recording of the practice interview (optional).

pro_course_detail.description:
This course is designed for intermediate to advanced (B1-C2) English students who want to improve their skills in all aspects of language (reading, writing, listening, and speaking). This class is ideal for students who want to prepare for exams such as IELTS which include a writing section.

What will my lesson be like?

• Before our lesson, you will select and complete a homework assignment from my website. These assignments cover a wide range of topics and are based on authentic video material (news reports, TED Talks, interviews, etc.).  After watching the video, you will answer comprehension questions, complete vocabulary exercises, and write a 3+ paragraph essay on the topic. Homework is required and should be submitted at least a day before the lesson time. 

• During our Zoom meeting, we will analyze your essay and complete grammar/vocabulary exercises based completely on the errors in your essay. By using your essay as the basis of our lesson, I will be able to efficiently identify gaps in your knowledge and avoid wasting time on learning things you've already mastered.  After we finish working through your essay, we will continue discussing the topic in greater depth through an authentic text.

• Students will receive a password to access the homework platform before the lesson. An individual Google Doc with class notes & corrections will be sent to each student. 

[If you do NOT want to work on reading/writing or receive homework please choose "Informal Tutoring" instead. If the student does not submit an assignment before class, a "Guided Conversation" class will be taught instead. All classes are conducted on Zoom.]
